author: scubaguy82
quote:
GTA 6 has a lot going for it, especially in the way it builds a living, busy world that feels fun to explore. The visuals and atmosphere are impressive, and the game clearly shows a lot of polish in animations, environments, and overall presentation.

That said, it doesn’t fully land for me. Some parts of the pacing felt uneven, and there were moments where the gameplay loop didn’t feel as fresh as I expected. I also wish certain systems were clearer or more streamlined, because it can take time to figure out what matters and how to best approach activities.

Overall, it’s an exciting entry, but it’s not perfect—and depending on what you value most, some flaws may be hard to ignore.
